discovery_observation.observation: The logged-out Binance Earn page displayed an RWUSD promotion at 3.36% APR but redirected the BFUSD product URL to the generic Earn page.
discovery_observation.reason: A logged-out promotion does not prove account eligibility, capacity, realized rate, entry cost, redemption cost, or a comparable BFUSD rate.

accepted_only_if: the exact account can subscribe and redeem the selected product at the evaluated size
the rate-history timestamp cadence is proved before rates are time-weighted
the conservative integrated target reward exceeds the exact integrated alternative cash yield
the positive differential also exceeds every entry redemption transfer delay custody tax and opportunity cost
a separately authorized minimum-size cycle later reconciles subscription rewards redemption and balances
economic_gate.alternative_yield_rule: Compare against the best exact eligible same-currency cash yield available to the account, never against an assumed zero-yield balance.
economic_gate.rate_cadence_rule: Do not assume one row equals one day. Derive effective intervals from returned timestamps and leave the final open interval uncredited unless its end is independently bound.
rejection_conditions: unproved account eligibility or quota at the evaluated size
break-even horizon longer than the proved rate persistence horizon
using documentation examples marketing APR or a public promotion as current account evidence

mechanism.name: same_account_stable_value_yield_allocation_between_bfusd_rwusd_and_cash_alternatives
mechanism.risk_boundary: The candidate avoids a crypto price-direction forecast but remains exposed to variable reward rates, issuer and venue custody, redemption delay and fee changes, product availability, stablecoin conversion, tax, and opportunity cost.

endpoints.evidence: account-specific BFUSD reported subscription quota plus fast and standard redemption quota minimum fee and delay; the documented response does not separately expose enabled-state fields
descending BFUSD annualPercentageRate observations with timestamps
account-specific RWUSD subscription capacity minimum and enabled state plus fast and standard redemption quota minimum fee and delay
descending RWUSD annualPercentageRate observations with timestamps
eligible USDT flexible alternatives including current rate tiers purchase redemption sold-out status and minimum
eligible USDC flexible alternatives including current rate tiers purchase redemption sold-out status and minimum

read_only_prequalification.execution_rule: Do not implement or freeze a signed collector while either designated ephemeral credential variable is absent. Once both are present, separately source-bind and hosted-verify a GET-only capture before its one permitted run.
read_only_prequalification.redaction_rule: Never serialize headers signatures query strings credential values or secret-derived material.

separately_authorized_realization_stage.authority_required: new explicit funded minimum-size authority after read-only prequalification passes
minimum_evidence: exact subscription debit and received product amount
rewards history rows reconciled to held position and balance changes
exact redemption amount fee arrival time and received stablecoin
complete same-currency cash flow including all external costs and foregone alternative yield
